blocks.text: The module documentation defines the before/after call contract, fail-open rules, ledger shape, Redis keys, and product constants. It explicitly excludes prompts, replies, and tool arguments from logs.
blocks.title: Metering contract and policy

blocks.text: Numeric, token, timestamp, label, and callable helpers turn external values into bounded protocol-safe forms and run synchronous collaborators away from the event loop.
blocks.title: Normalization helpers

blocks.text: RunCeilingPolicy chooses an injected ceiling, an environment override, or a fraction of the account pool, and independently computes one grant chunk.
blocks.title: Ceiling policy

blocks.text: RunBudgetStore reads and writes raised ceilings and per-scope warning flags with a shared TTL. Restore supports undoing a replaced grant.
blocks.title: Redis budget state

blocks.text: ledger_run_credits reads this run's m2c credits. _RunState keeps totals and warnings across turns, while make_metering_factory injects collaborators and bounds the state LRU.
blocks.title: Ledger and factory state

blocks.text: RunMetering exposes spent and ceiling, hydrates persisted state, reads account quota, refreshes a raised ceiling near exhaustion, and raises BudgetPause for known exhaustion.
blocks.title: Pre-call enforcement

blocks.text: after_call prices reported usage, commits a ledger row, updates run counters, emits usage, and invokes account/run warning logic. Event failures are isolated from metering state.
blocks.title: Post-call accounting and notices

purpose: The loop asks this module before and after each model call. It reads shared quota state, prices measured tokens, commits one ledger row, tracks bounded per-run state, and pauses only when a known limit is reached.
summary: Enforces per-run and account credit limits, records model usage, and emits budget notices for the agent loop.
